title: Oven Roasted Portuguese Tofu Tagine
description: A mustardy and velvety Portuguese dish featuring matcha and infused oil, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This plant-based friendly recipe is cooked in a ceramic tagine.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the matcha powder and infused oil in a small bowl.
Add the mustard, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
Place the tofu, onion, and potatoes in the ceramic tagine.
Pour the matcha and mustard mixture over the tofu and vegetables.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
